sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: The Google Groups page lets you create, edit and delete your Google Workspace groups (mailing lists).

bullets.desc: Filter by group name or email address.
Long lists are paginated; use "Load More" to fetch the rest.
Each row has edit and delete buttons.

sections.heading: Creating & Editing Groups
paragraphs: Use the "New Group" button to create a group. When editing a group the form is tabbed:

bullets.desc: Add/remove members and assign roles (Owner / Manager / Member).
Who can post to the group and view its content.
Define additional (alias) email addresses for the group.

sections.heading: Auditing
paragraphs: All group operations are performed with the permissions of the signed-in admin.

callout.text: In the Workspace audit log, you always appear as the actor — not a service account.
